text: The Nominating Panel – Toronto Local Appeal Body will conduct interviews and recommend six candidates to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Local Appeal Body.

The Nominating Panel – Toronto Local Appeal Body recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the follow candidates to the Toronto Local Appeal Body for a term of office ending February 9, 2028, and until successors are appointed: Ana Bassios Anthony Brown Brian Gallaugher Yeta Herscher Bruce Mullock John Tassiopoulos
